name: azip
title: AZIP Z-machine Interpreter
author: John D. Holder (JZip); Louis Davis (AZIP)
about: Plays Infocom and Inform text adventures (Z-code .z1-.z8 or .dat). /sd/roms/pax/azip.rom holds the story path; the default is /sd/roms/pax/GAME.DAT (Mini-Zork I). Saves are written next to the story as <story>.sav. A USB keyboard is needed to type commands.
controls: USB keyboard: type commands, Enter to submit
Menu or L3: quit to launcher

requires.note: Optional text file containing the chosen story path

extract.instructions:
Provide the complete matching data set from your original installation or the verified download choice below. Keep filenames and subfolders as listed.

Choose a Z-code story with Select game, or put its full path in /sd/roms/pax/azip.rom. A USB keyboard is needed.

FILES / FOLDERS

/sd/roms/pax/GAME.DAT (or a chosen /sd/roms/azip/*.z* story) — A Z-machine story file; alternatively /sd/roms/pax/GAME.DAT

/sd/roms/pax/azip.rom — Optional text file containing the chosen story path

requires.note: Optional text file containing the chosen story path
